verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer is documented as an in-product AI debugging agent that automatically root-causes issues and, via Autofix, generates suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues. Its root-cause analysis can also be handed to coding agents to produce fixes. This is AI-generated insight and suggestion drawn directly from the user's monitoring data. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's output quality, evidence of AI insights beyond issue debugging (e.g., dashboards, trends, natural-language querying of data), and availability without a separate paid Seer subscription.
